beats.text: Traditional 3D graphics hit an impossible memory wall the moment you try rendering realistic lighting.
beats.visual_focus: Discrete voxel grid shattering under memory pressure as light rays fail to resolve

beats.text: Discrete voxel grids scale cubically like empty storage lockers, devouring gigabytes of memory while failing miserably on delicate geometry and glossy reflections.
beats.visual_focus: Massive 3D voxel grid showing millions of empty redundant cells and aliased jagged edges

beats.text: NeRF abandons physical polygons completely, compressing an entire continuous visual scene into a compact fully-connected network taking five-dimensional coordinates.
beats.visual_focus: A 5D vector (x, y, z, theta, phi) entering an MLP and outputting continuous color and density
